title: Implement Automatic Route Caching for Improved Performance
description: This feature matters as it will improve the performance of the yantraverse framework by reducing the time it takes to resolve routes. It will achieve this by caching the results of route resolution, so that subsequent requests to the same route can be served more quickly. This will have a significant impact on the overall responsiveness of applications built with yantraverse
testCases: Test route caching with multiple requests to the same route
Test route caching with requests to different routes
acceptance: Route caching is successfully implemented and improves performance by at least 20%
reason: Technical justification: Route caching is a common optimization technique used in many frameworks to improve performance, and its implementation will bring yantraverse more in line with industry standards
